payload.blocks: Landing phase 1 (fgos authority locate), and through it phases 5, 7 and 11.
payload.headline: Add test/rust-host/vectors/envelope/version.json to the authority-doors footprint to regenerate its verb list?

parts.cause: The lead ran node test/rust-host/generate-vectors.mjs --check on branch component-authority-doors/p01c and it reports 'Drift in envelope/version.json'. test/rust-host/envelope-contract.test.mjs fails 3 of 21. The reviewer reproduced cargo test -p fgos-distribution test_vector_parity_version failing at packages/distribution/rust/src/lib.rs:511.

options.cost: One footprint line; the file change is generated, no hand edits.
options.does: Adds test/rust-host/vectors/envelope/version.json to the plan footprint (phases 1 and 5). A unit runs node test/rust-host/generate-vectors.mjs and commits only that file.
options.gain: npm test and cargo test go green, and phase 1 lands. Phase 5 needs the same file for declare.
options.harm: Another shared generated file, so any plan adding a verb meets it at admission.
options.label: A. Add the vector file to the footprint

options.cost: A red main until someone fixes it.
options.does: Lands the branch with the stale vector and leaves the regeneration to someone else.
options.harm: main goes red for every plan, which breaks the DoD and blocks other lands' gates.
options.label: B. Land phase 1 red and regenerate later

parts.recommendation: A: it is generated output of the verb registry, the same kind of registration file as main.rs and catalog.rs, and the regeneration is mechanical.

scope.allows: Adding test/rust-host/vectors/envelope/version.json to the plan footprint (phases 1 and 5), changed only by running test/rust-host/generate-vectors.mjs.
scope.forbids: Hand edits to any vector, and regenerating other vector files.

parts.what: Phase 1 is done and green on its own checks: the verb test passes on both sentences, crate 8/8, route and drift tests 44/44. The second review found that a generated vector, test/rust-host/vectors/envelope/version.json, holds the sorted verb list and was not regenerated for the new verb. That keeps npm test and cargo test red, and the file is outside the footprint.
